title: Synthesis, Structure, and Phosphatase-Like Activity of a New Trinuclear Gd Complex with the Unsymmetrical Ligand H3L As a Model for Nucleases

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: trinuclear gadolinium complex of unsymmetrical ligand H3L

synthesis.procedure: Complex 1 was prepared by adding Gd(NO3)3·6H2O to a methanolic solution containing ligand H3L and NaOH in 3:2:6 stoichiometry, under magnetic stirring at 40 °C for 40 min. After total solvent evaporation, the solid was recrystallized from methanol/ethanol/acetone (1:1:1) to give colorless single crystals suitable for X-ray analysis.

reagents.name: gadolinium(III) nitrate hexahydrate
reagents.amount: 3 equiv (3:2:6 stoichiometry vs H3L and NaOH)

synthesis.vessel_or_method: magnetic stirring in methanol, then solvent evaporation and recrystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: total solvent evaporation followed by recrystallization from methanol/ethanol/acetone (1:1:1) yielding colorless monocrystals
